{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonic scanner''' was a type of [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]]. It could scan for sounds above or below the operator's hearing range, or amplify sounds captured at long-range.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

It was a mid-range scanning device for reconnaissance and to intercept and decode communication signals. They could also be used to sweep an area for listening devices.

[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] was known to use a sonic scanner.
